question: Should OpenClaw accept the Codex action v1.11 runner-namespace changes together with the other grouped action updates?
rationale: The v1.11 pin changes privileged GitHub-hosted runner preparation in workflows that receive API keys, and repository policy requires explicit handling of the protected security surface rather than an automated merge judgment.

options.title: Approve after exact-head validation
options.body: Rebase, finish relevant workflow checks, verify the official action SHAs, and merge the grouped update with explicit acceptance of the Codex runner changes.

options.title: Separate the Codex upgrade
options.body: Split the Codex action pin into its own security-reviewed PR while allowing the lower-risk action updates to proceed independently.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head validation
recommendation.body: Rebase, finish relevant workflow checks, verify the official action SHAs, and merge the grouped update with explicit acceptance of the Codex runner changes.
